threshold_basis: Prospective supervision/context contract, not fitted to any model scores or held-out labels: 0.5-1.5 seconds of observed post-onset context on the existing 0.5s streaming grid, at least 0.25s of guaranteed reviewed descent, at most 0.5s past the earliest possible motion end. Annotation uncertainty must be stated honestly; never infer onset or impact from an operator action interval. These defaults need prospective collection validation and are not empirically optimized thresholds.
